newsletters.topic_focus: Focus on new tissue research and regenerative medicine with search terms "tissue research" and "regenerative medicine." This filter applies to source-list articles as well as discovered ones; do not include general biology news that doesn't connect to tissue research or regenerative medicine. Prioritize university news service articles about recent faculty research. Only include coverage of new/recent findings, not reviews or older studies. Favor U.S.-based research; occasional international research is fine but shouldn't dominate. Studies on non-human species are only relevant if the article draws an explicit connection to human tissue or disease. Flag rather than auto-include any article primarily about stem cell therapy (embryonic or engineered stem cells) AATB readers are sensitive to this topic. Target 5 articles for this section. Summarize each in one sentence that does not begin with "The article."
